segments.text: Why does sending ETH to someone else still cost 21,000 gas, while sending it to yourself costs 12,000?
Glamsterdam replaces that flat charge with named pieces. A normal send stays 21,000.
Twelve thousand for the sender, three thousand to touch the recipient, six thousand to move the value.
A self-send drops the recipient and the value charge. Only twelve thousand remains.
No value moved. Fifteen thousand: the sender, plus the recipient touch.
Now the same self-send, one fork earlier.
The flat twenty-one thousand comes back.
Someone else, twenty-one thousand. Yourself, twelve thousand. No value, fifteen thousand. Fusaka charges twenty-one thousand for all three.
Read the schedule on Forkcast. Run the three shapes on feelyourprotocol dot org.
